title: Excerpt props, resolved
description: An excerpt as the board document holds it (AD-12; proposal B8). By pointer: its `status`; when `resolved`, the source `text` (its lines joined by LF, possibly empty), its `mediaType` and its `lines`; when `unresolved`, its `reason` and nothing read. Written by the agent: its `text`, with no status. The `$defs` are the context's shared shapes, which the reference and image props reference too. The contract's validation function checks that `lines.start` is at most `lines.end`.

reason.description: Why a pointer stays unresolved, as the `unresolved-pointer` warning names it.

textMediaType.description: `text/markdown` for `.md` and `.markdown`, `text/plain` otherwise; it decides only how the text wraps.

imageMediaType.description: An image recognised by its first bytes; SVG is none of them.

lines.description: A range of 1-based lines, both ends included.
